title: MatMix Duo #21 (재질 섞기 듀오 · 이레즈미 / 옥 백옥 · 체형 hourglass bombshell, BBW bombshell · 인종 blue-black, Slavic · 메이크업 클래식 레드립 극한 ‖ 메이크업 비닐 블랙립 3단계 · 강함 · 배경 쇼핑 아케이드 · 힐 40인치 · 몸 주얼리)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side.

#1: a deep blue-black complexion, mid 50s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, sculpted updo lavender hair — full body dragon phoenix irezumi covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE. Bold black ink outlines — BLAZING ELECTRIC GOLD dragon coiling the full torso and both legs neck to ankle, VIVID CRIMSON phoenix wings spreading across the full chest, NO airbrush NO gradient wash. Pose: walking confidently toward the camera, shoulders back, chin lifted — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
#1: Footwear: thigh-high platform stiletto boots entirely in the exact same colours as her own body art — blazing electric gold and vivid crimson — NOT black, NOT dark, NOT plain — the footwear must be a bright, saturated, glossy colour taken straight from her own body art, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
#1: Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, painted in the same colours as her body art.
#1: Jewelry: a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, a gold belly chain with a small pendant at her navel, and a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
#1: Face: her face and ears are NOT painted — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: thick lacquer-glossy saturated pillar-box red lips overlined fuller than natural, a razor-sharp long winged liner, dramatic lashes, a flawless matte complexion with sculpted cheekbones.

#2: a fair porcelain complexion with a cool undertone, mid 50s goddess, BBW bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most massive full-figure BBW body ever at absolute maximum in every dimension, hips so wide beyond proportion dominating the entire frame, bust so enormous overwhelming gravity, waist deeply snatched despite impossible volume, sleek slicked-back honey blonde hair — full body polished carved white mutton-fat jade fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is solid jade curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted jade sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING creamy milk-white mutton-fat jade surface across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID faint pale-green and russet-gold veins running between the sections, with silver filigree inlay curling across the sections, soft waxy-gloss polished, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: leaning a shoulder against the doorway, one knee bent, a hand on her thigh — most extreme BBW bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
#2: Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of the same jade, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
#2: Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, made of the same jade with a high polish.
#2: Jewelry: a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, and a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
#2: Face: her face and ears are NOT jade — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Russian woman with high cheekbones, light eyes and a defined jaw, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: wet-look black gradient eyeshadow with a chrome highlight on the lids, a graphic black liner, sleek lashes, high-shine black vinyl lips like polished glass, a cool matte contour.

Environment: a bright glass-vaulted shopping arcade with a polished marble floor, standard-height shop doors and a long bench, completely empty, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as any of them.
All: Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. CRITICAL: all 2 women's legs must show FULL BODY ART coverage from hip to ankle to toe with NO bare untattooed skin visible anywhere, every element standing in true relief, nothing flat. TWO completely different extreme physiques must CONTRAST and DOMINATE every inch of frame. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 3:4 aspect ratio.
